metadata.title: DPIA template — CNIL PIA
metadata.description:
**Data Protection Impact Assessment** skeleton inspired by the **CNIL PIA** method. Four-level grid whose risk level is defined **per cell** (not by product), with custom fields specific to the approach.

To complete: context and processors, then for each feared event (illegitimate access, unwanted modification, unavailability) the scenarios, their initial and residual rating, and the action plan.

vertical_axis.label: Likelihood
vertical_axis.description: Possibility that a risk occurs, given asset vulnerabilities and risk sources.

levels.label: Negligible
levels.description: It does not seem possible for the threat to occur.

levels.label: Limited
levels.description: It seems difficult for risk sources to carry out the threat.

levels.label: Significant
levels.description: It seems possible for risk sources to carry out the threat.

levels.label: Maximum
levels.description: It seems extremely easy for risk sources to carry out the threat.

horizontal_axis.label: Severity
horizontal_axis.description: Extent of the risk, assessed against potential impacts on data subjects.

levels.label: Negligible
levels.description: Data subjects will not be affected or will overcome minor inconveniences without difficulty.

levels.label: Limited
levels.description: Data subjects may face significant inconveniences, surmountable despite difficulties.

levels.label: Significant
levels.description: Data subjects may face significant consequences, surmountable but with real difficulties.

levels.label: Maximum
levels.description: Data subjects may face significant, even irreversible consequences they might not overcome.

criticality_levels.label: Negligible
criticality_levels.description: Negligible risk level per the PIA method.

criticality_levels.label: Limited
criticality_levels.description: Limited risk level per the PIA method.

criticality_levels.label: Significant
criticality_levels.description: Significant risk level: reduction measures are expected.

criticality_levels.label: Maximum
criticality_levels.description: Maximum risk level: the processing cannot be carried out as is.

description.fr: Sous-traitants au sens de l'article 28 du RGPD (ou équivalent), et objet de leur intervention.
description.en: Processors within the meaning of Article 28 GDPR (or equivalent), and the purpose of their involvement.
description.it: Responsabili del trattamento ai sensi dell'articolo 28 GDPR (o equivalente), e oggetto del loro intervento.

description.fr: Catalogue des mesures déjà en place, tenues hors du registre des mesures (réservé aux actions du plan d'action).
description.en: Catalogue of measures already in place, kept out of the measures register (reserved for action-plan items).
description.it: Catalogo delle misure già in atto, tenute fuori dal registro delle misure (riservato alle azioni del piano d'azione).

description.fr: Violation de confidentialité : des données personnelles sont consultées par des personnes non autorisées
description.en: Confidentiality breach: personal data is accessed by unauthorised persons
description.it: Violazione della riservatezza: dati personali consultati da persone non autorizzate

description.fr: Violation d'intégrité : des données sont altérées, faussées ou modifiées de façon non voulue
description.en: Integrity breach: data is altered, corrupted or changed in an unintended way
description.it: Violazione dell'integrità: dati alterati, falsati o modificati in modo indesiderato

description.fr: Violation de disponibilité : des données deviennent inaccessibles, perdues ou détruites
description.en: Availability breach: data becomes inaccessible, lost or destroyed
description.it: Violazione della disponibilità: dati resi inaccessibili, persi o distrutti

description.fr: Personne interne à l'organisme agissant intentionnellement pour nuire
description.en: Person inside the organisation acting deliberately to cause harm
description.it: Persona interna all'organismo che agisce intenzionalmente per nuocere

description.fr: Personne interne provoquant un dommage par erreur, négligence ou méconnaissance
description.en: Insider causing harm through error, negligence or lack of awareness
description.it: Persona interna che provoca un danno per errore, negligenza o inconsapevolezza

description.fr: Acteur extérieur à l'organisme cherchant à exploiter ou compromettre les données
description.en: Actor outside the organisation seeking to exploit or compromise the data
description.it: Attore esterno all'organismo che cerca di sfruttare o compromettere i dati

description.fr: Sous-traitant ou fournisseur ayant accès aux données dans le cadre de sa prestation
description.en: Subcontractor or supplier with access to the data as part of its service
description.it: Subappaltatore o fornitore con accesso ai dati nell'ambito della propria prestazione

description.fr: Source non humaine : défaillance matérielle, sinistre ou événement naturel affectant les supports
description.en: Non-human source: hardware failure, disaster or natural event affecting the media
description.it: Fonte non umana: guasto materiale, sinistro o evento naturale che colpisce i supporti

description.fr: Équipements physiques hébergeant les données (serveurs, postes, supports amovibles)
description.en: Physical equipment hosting the data (servers, workstations, removable media)
description.it: Apparecchiature fisiche che ospitano i dati (server, postazioni, supporti rimovibili)

description.fr: Programmes et systèmes d'exploitation traitant les données personnelles
description.en: Programs and operating systems processing the personal data
description.it: Programmi e sistemi operativi che trattano i dati personali

description.fr: Voie de transmission électronique des données (réseaux, connexions informatiques)
description.en: Electronic channel transmitting the data (networks, IT connections)
description.it: Canale di trasmissione elettronica dei dati (reti, connessioni informatiche)

description.fr: Documents imprimés ou manuscrits contenant des données personnelles
description.en: Printed or handwritten documents containing personal data
description.it: Documenti stampati o manoscritti contenenti dati personali

description.fr: Moyen d'acheminement physique des documents (courrier, transport de papier)
description.en: Physical means of conveying documents (mail, transport of paper)
description.it: Mezzo di trasporto fisico dei documenti (posta, trasporto cartaceo)

description.fr: Individu détenteur ou porteur de connaissances relatives aux données
description.en: Individual holding or possessing knowledge relating to the data
description.it: Individuo detentore o portatore di conoscenze relative ai dati

description.fr: Atteinte à l'intégrité physique de la personne concernée (blessure, atteinte à la santé)
description.en: Harm to the physical integrity of the data subject (injury, harm to health)
description.it: Lesione dell'integrità fisica dell'interessato (ferite, danno alla salute)

description.fr: Préjudice patrimonial ou financier subi par la personne (perte, fraude, coûts)
description.en: Material or financial loss suffered by the data subject (loss, fraud, costs)
description.it: Pregiudizio patrimoniale o finanziario subito dalla persona (perdita, frode, costi)

description.fr: Atteinte psychologique ou à la réputation (détresse, discrimination, humiliation)
description.en: Psychological or reputational harm (distress, discrimination, humiliation)
description.it: Danno psicologico o alla reputazione (sofferenza, discriminazione, umiliazione)

description.fr: Mesure ajoutée spécifiquement pour réduire un risque identifié
description.en: Measure added specifically to reduce an identified risk
description.it: Misura aggiunta specificamente per ridurre un rischio individuato

description.fr: Renforcement ou adaptation d'une mesure déjà en place
description.en: Strengthening or adaptation of a measure already in place
description.it: Rafforzamento o adattamento di una misura già in essere

description.fr: Exigence fondamentale du RGPD (finalité, minimisation, base légale) à respecter en tout état de cause
description.en: Fundamental GDPR requirement (purpose, minimisation, legal basis) to be met in all cases
description.it: Requisito fondamentale del GDPR (finalità, minimizzazione, base giuridica) da rispettare in ogni caso

description.fr: Action à mettre en œuvre au plus vite : le traitement ne peut être conduit sans elle.
description.en: Action to implement as soon as possible: the processing cannot proceed without it.
description.it: Azione da attuare al più presto: il trattamento non può procedere senza di essa.
